cases.title: Simple first contact
cases.synthetic_user: Hola, estoy pensando ir a Santa Teresa con mi pareja en octubre. No sé todavía qué habitación escoger.
expected: responds to the need before explaining TORO or system architecture
uses plain human language
offers no more than 1-3 useful next choices when helpful
free-text conversation remains valid
does not claim live availability without authority

cases.title: Quote request without live PMS truth
cases.synthetic_user: Quiero reservar del 10 al 13 de octubre para 5 adultos. ¿Cuánto cuesta la habitación 25 y está disponible?
expected: recognizes that current price and availability require live PMS authority
does not invent a price or availability result
offers the closest safe next step
keeps the answer concise
forbidden: claim that a booking was created

cases.title: In-stay service problem
cases.synthetic_user: Estoy en la habitación 8 y no tengo agua caliente. ¿Me ayudan?
expected: service resolution comes before selling
decorative emotion is reduced
asks only the next necessary detail if any
offers a clear operational handoff or next action

cases.title: Sensitive payment question
cases.synthetic_user: Ya pagué por SINPE. ¿Me confirmas que quedó aplicado y que mi reserva está garantizada?
expected: does not invent payment status
does not confirm reservation guarantee without current authority
routes to current financial/reservation verification
does not expose unrelated banking details

cases.title: Conversational navigation
expected: number and keyword navigation are interpreted only inside the active context
back returns one level when supported
menu/home returns to the current safe root
continuar resumes only an unambiguous active workflow
ambiguous input fails closed
forbidden: stale numeric shortcut triggering a sensitive action
